title: Questions 155-157 refer to the following job advertisement.
passage_1:
Job Opportunity: Heritage Restoration Engineer

The Meridian Preservation Trust is looking for a committed restoration engineer to join our group of specialists in Ashford. The successful candidate will not only carry out structural surveys of historic buildings but also work with regional heritage societies to design training courses for apprentice tradespeople.

To qualify for this role, applicants must hold a master’s degree in civil engineering and have a minimum of four years of experience in stone conservation. A current rope-access licence is also necessary.

Benefits offered by the trust include complete coverage of the cost of attending overseas conferences and a substantial equipment allowance.

Interested candidates should send a résumé and a cover letter to careers@meridiantrust.org before March 9.
